name: Compute Cluster S01: NaN Production
description: Tests: where(cond, val) for NaN injection.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)
big_up = ret > 0.01
big_moves = where(big_up, ret)
xy_lines(title='NaN Production', category='NaN', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Big Moves', color=Color.Blue)]))(x_values=index(), y_values=big_moves)
